text:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate for model-runner-prod (alert: inference.gateway.5xx_rate > 4% over 2m). see alert link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/6112233445

oncall-elaine: I'm on it. pulling up runbooks.

sre-ledger: seeing a sharp spike in OOMs from model-runner pods in us-east-1. approx 30% of replicas restarted in last 3m.

andrew: stack traces show repeated segfault in native kernel during attention kernel init. short snippet from pod log:```E2026-03-17T20:10:12Z model-runner[pid=2345]: segfault at 0x7ffe... ip 0x55aa kernel_attention_init +0x128```

maria-support: customers reporting timeouts on conversational endpoints (tickets #5734, #5737). impact: some requests 502/504, a subset of high-token requests.

eng-runtime: rolling quantized kernel patch is suspected. recent rollout of q-attn v2 at 20:03 UTC. reverting might be fastest mitigation.

oncall-elaine: can we route traffic to fallback model variant w/ default attention kernel? product-ops, can we toggle routing?

product-ops: yes, we can flip a routing policy. proposing: 25% diverted to stable-variant immediately, then 100% if error rates don't improve in 5m.

sre-ledger: ops plan: cordon affected nodes, restart pods gradually, enable auto-fallback to dedicated small model on gateway. doing cordon now.

eng-runtime: to revert: kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=image:redwood/q-attn:v1.9 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner. if we need faster, use traffic-split:```rbac: traffic split: stable:1, canary:0```

andrew: attaching sample core dump backtrace (minimal):```#0 0x55aa in kernel_attention_init+0x128
#1 0x45b3 in model_init+0x33
#2 0x3f11 in handle_request+0x88```

maria-support: updating customers on ETA. telling them we have mitigation in progress and will follow up in 10m.

oncall-elaine: doing the traffic-split to stable variant now. product-ops please confirm after flip.

product-ops: flipped to stable variant 25% at 20:12 UTC. monitoring.

sre-ledger: after flip, 5xx rate dropped from 6.2% to 3.4% at edge within 90s. still above baseline but improving.

eng-runtime: running hot patch job to revert quant kernel at cluster edge. if patch fails, fallback is full rollback.

andrew: test-run shows kernel init fails deterministically on long sequences > 8k tokens. might be a memory indexing bug in quant path.

product-ops: scaling up dedicated capacity in us-east-1 by +10 replicas as buffer.

oncall-elaine: paging oncall-night for handoff in 25m. summary so far: root cause likely q-attn:v2 kernel bug causing segfaults/OOMs on long sequences; mitigation: traffic split -> stable variant, cordon nodes, restart pods, patch revert in flight. customer impact: reduced 5xx, some timeouts persist for heavy requests; support notified.

oncall-night: I see the thread. I'll take over the watch at 20:35 UTC. next steps: confirm rollback completes, watch for regression on latency, run canary tests with representative long-seq prompts.

maria-support: posted interim status to affected customers. will escalate any critical responses.

eng-runtime: rollback started at 20:20 UTC, rollout 20%/min. monitoring rollout status:```kubectl rollout status deploy/model-runner --watch```

sre-ledger: leaving notes in incident log: cordoned nodes: node-12-ax, node-14-bx. restarted pods: model-runner-7, -9, -12.

oncall-elaine: closing immediate pager. handoff: oncall-night is primary. if 5xx > 3% for 5m escalate to eng-runtime and SRE pager.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded. incident#INC-6112233445 state=mitigated, owners=[oncall-night,eng-runtime].

oncall-night: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring and will open a follow-up postmortem ticket to root cause the quant kernel memory indexing on long sequences.

maria-support: will prepare a short customer-facing blurb once rollback completes and we confirm stable metrics. :thumbsup:

eng-runtime: noted. I'll preserve core dumps and upload to internal crash repo: https://crashes.redwood/6112233445-core-archive

sre-ledger: final check: 5xx at 0.9% after full rollback. marking as mitigated at 20:34 UTC.

oncall-night: thanks team — handoff complete.
